profile.headline: Google Software Engineer who blogs about the NBA
profile.summary:
Currently a full-time software engineer at Google, part-time NBA thoughts blogger and a fuller-time husband/dad.

NBA substack: https://dallinnba.substack.com/

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implementing experimental features to increase subscriptions through Google Play.
- Designed the solution and led the implementation on a multi-team effort for adding essential refund functionality for Google Play.
- Engaged in the effort to automate processes to ensure that Play Developers keep the terms & conditions of regulation-mandated alternative billing programs.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Developed a summary view feature for an internal reporting tool within Capital One Auto Finance. Led the product management of this feature, while also being the primary frontend Angular developer.
- Assisted (on a different team) the enhancement of the principal Test Data Management Platform within Capital One, designing new frontend features and building them in Vue.js.

positions.title: Data Engineer
positions.description:
- Built an automated sensitive data remediation framework that replaces sensitive data with masked values using Python, PySpark, Snowflake, and S3.
- Lead the development on the framework with guidance from engineering leadership.

positions.title: Software Development Intern - Tools/DaaS
positions.description:
Create a condition-tree optimization algorithm for improving speed of their Condition Item evaluations
Form complex Hive & SQL queries to obtain essential data for the algorithm
Present to Product Management and Engineering leadership on the potential impact of our findings

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Finding more efficient and faster algorithms for solving systems of polynomials by using Groebner bases and Chebysheb Polynomials

positions.title: Writing Fellow
positions.description:
Revise students’ writing in global organization and sentence-level structure 
Meet individually with students to understand them and work together to improve their writing
Collaborate with other Writing Fellows assigned to the same class to enhance each student's experience

positions.title: Lab Supervisor/TA
positions.description:
- Assisting other students in the fundamentals of programming
- Judging the quality of the code written by the students

positions.title: Private Equity Intern
positions.description:
Prepared a report on a limited partner investor’s portfolio performance in the last year
Planned possible marketing strategies to enhance user experience on the company website
Assisted a marketing associate in orchestrating the annual Limited Partner Update Calls

certifications.name: Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect Associate
certifications.title: Amazon Web Services Solutions Architect Associate

volunteerExperiences.companyName: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints
volunteerExperiences.description:
	Learned to speak fluent Spanish in order to communicate with and teach the residents of the area
	Contacted thousands of new people over the span of two years in form of casual conversation and in formal settings
	Served in leadership positions to up to 24 missionaries to train in communication skills, creative thinking, and development of self-confidence to work more effectively
	Served as companion to eight others from 6 different Spanish speaking countries
